definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the face below the eyes.

examples.japanese: {涙|なみだ}が{頬|ほお}を{伝|つた}った。
{赤|あか}ちゃんの{頬|ほお}はふっくらしている。

notes:
Can be read as either ほお or ほほ, with ほお being more common in modern usage.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
・{頬|ほお} - more common
・{頬|ほほ} - also used

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{頬|ほお}を{染|そ}める (to blush)
・{頬|ほお}を{赤|あか}らめる (to turn red in the face)
・{頬|ほお}を{膨|ふく}らませる (to puff out one's cheeks - sulking)
・{頬骨|ほおぼね} (cheekbone)
・{頬|ほお}{紅|べに} (blush, rouge)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{頬|ほお}が{落|お}ちる (so delicious one's cheeks might fall off)
・{頬|ほお}を{つねる} (to pinch one's cheek - to check if dreaming)
